reasoning: The glyph shows a headless lower body seated in an L-shaped seat profile (derived from automotive HVAC footwell icons). It works well for tasks about selecting travel seats, legroom, car seats, or sitting ergonomics, though the cropped upper body makes it slightly less obvious than a full chair or full seated figure.
